dedupe_keys.name: emasanet globaldcanalysis data center energy model 15 feb 2020

description: Eric Masanet and coauthors publish an Excel model used to analyse global data-centre energy demand. Zenodo archives a February 2020 GlobalDCAnalysis release as other-open software, and the linked GitHub repository states MIT. The description says the workbook includes its model structure, input data, results, sources, figures and discussion of uncertainty for the Science paper on recalibrating worldwide data-centre electricity use. It can support alternative assumptions about server stock, efficiency or electricity demand in digital-infrastructure simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this workbook. Coverage is global but tied to the 2020 study’s definitions and input vintages, not a live current data-centre census. A limitation is that the older GlobalDC Zenodo release appears to be an earlier snapshot of the same paper model; neither workbook was opened, so cell-by-cell differences are not established. Results may be stale for modern AI data-centre loads. No formula or energy total was independently recalculated.
